analyst.summary: Welspun Enterprises develops road (HAM model) and water-sector infrastructure projects. Revenue growth turned negative over the last year after a positive 3-year trend, and working capital days have roughly doubled (91.5 to 182), signaling real collection or execution friction. The company is divesting a stake (WASPPL) for about Rs.1,000 Cr, pending approval by September 2026 -- a genuine but one-off deleveraging event rather than an operating improvement. At roughly 21-25 times earnings, we rate this a Sell given the recent operating deceleration.
